correctness.rationale: In a cycle C_n the distance-r sphere has 2 vertices below the diameter, 1 at the maximum when n even, and 2 at the maximum when n odd. Three reusable variable names express bounded graph distance by recursive existential intermediates and exact spheres, so predicates P_n(x) identify precisely components of size n. With at most max(s,3) names, s<=k vertices are forced into distinct C_n components by pairwise nonreachability within the cycle diameter, detecting multiplicity up to k. Conversely the indefinitely played k-pebble game pairs occupied equal-length cycles and allows at most k-1 occupied components before a response; truncated counts ensure an available matching component. Two-pebble adjacency/equality classes are exactly complete C3 versus other nonempty 2-regular graphs, and one pebble sees only equality/self-loops. Strictness follows k vs k+1 triangles. Independent distance-layer computations for single cycles n=3..25 corroborate, not replace, this proof.
